description: Fork of exp732 (val=1.3912 @ 276.8M, fp32 LUT storage + standard Lion, no grad clip). Identical train.py + config. The change is in src/spiky/lutorch/fast_multi_head_lut.py: the body now explicitly casts fp32 weights to bf16 before embedding_bag (which is not autocast-eligible). So LUT compute is now bf16 throughout — gather + einsums — matching the bf16 compute path of bf16-storage runs. Storage stays fp32, grad accumulation stays fp32. Compare to exp732 = 1.3912 (PARTIAL bf16 compute, fp32 gather) and exp737 v2 = 1.3872 (FULL bf16 compute via bf16 storage). If exp747 ≈ 1.3872, the gap was the bf16 gather precision. If exp747 ≈ 1.3912, the gap was from bf16-storage-specific noise (e.g. grad-buffer rounding under grad_accum=2).
